=Write a fresh, engaging personal-finance newsletter edition for a general audience. Current time: {{ $now.toFormat("cccc, LLLL d, yyyy - t") }}.

Here are the latest REAL financial news headlines, aggregated moments ago from Yahoo Finance, CNBC, MarketWatch and Investing.com:
{{ $json.headlines }}

Return ONLY the body content (no email headers, no HTML). Structure it in plain text with these clearly labeled sections:

TITLE: a short catchy title for this edition (one line)
MARKET: a 3-4 sentence "Market Pulse" — summarize in plain English what today's headlines above mean for an everyday person. Reference the actual themes from the headlines across the different sources. Keep it general and educational, NOT individualized investment advice.
TIP: one actionable money tip of the hour (2-3 sentences)
CONCEPT: explain one financial concept simply (budgeting, investing, debt, saving, taxes, insurance, or credit) in 3-4 sentences
QUOTE: one motivating money/finance quote with its author
ACTION: one small concrete action the reader can take today (1 sentence)

Keep it upbeat, practical, and beginner-friendly. Do not give individualized investment advice; keep it general and educational.
